subject: Your 3-night challenge starts tonight
preview_text: Commit to three nights with your partner, starting tonight. See what happens with SoulPlan.
body_paragraphs: What if I told you that three small choices over the next three nights could change how your partner sees you? Not because you're trying harder, but because you're planning smarter. That's the bet I'm making with you.

Here's the challenge: Tonight, open SoulPlan and tap Tonight's Date. Pick one mood — cozy, adventurous, playful, healing. That's it. Don't overthink it. Tomorrow night, do the same again. And the night after that. Three dates in three days. No planning, no stress, just a gesture that says 'I see you.' Couples who take this challenge report feeling closer, more connected, and less stuck in routine. It's not magic — it's a small commitment that builds momentum.

This challenge is built into SoulPlan's DNA. Tonight's Date takes 30 seconds from tap to done. Your partner gets a 'thought of you tonight' moment that beats any bare notification. And after three nights, your Memory Timeline starts to grow — a scrapbook that proves you showed up. The streak counter keeps you honest, but if life gets wild, the no-shame freeze pauses without penalty. You're not committing to perfection — just three nights.

Ready to prove to yourself that the spark isn't gone? Open SoulPlan and tap Tonight's Date. Set your mood. Make tonight the first of three. P.S. After night three, check your Memory Timeline together — you might be surprised what you remember.
